svg.text: gemma4-E2B · GSM8K accuracy-parity benchmark: identical recipe, identical scorer, two platforms
Frozen, identical on both sides
• google/gemma-4-E2B-it (HF rev 3e22461f)
• GSM8K train 7473 Q (shuffle seed) / test 1319 Q
• native <|turn> chat template, one <bos>
• system prompt "…final answer within \boxed{}"
• GRPO: 128 prompts × 16 samples, T=1.0, top_p 1, top_k −1
• token TIS w=min(exp(Δlogp),3), LR 2e-6 cosine, 250 updates
• eval every 20 updates: greedy, 1319 Q, scorer-v2
GPU reference (frozen)
verl + vLLM, 16 nodes × 8 GPUs, FSDP
3 seeds · gemma4_e2b_gsm8k8k_16n64g_s250_seed{1,2,3}
per-eval: acc_v2, Wilson 95 %, boxed, tokens, flips
per-step: k3 KL 3.4–5e-4, ESS ≥ 0.999, grad-norm
step time 31.7 / 33.1 / 35.0 s (seed medians)
step-250 acc_v2: 92.42 ± 0.42 (3-seed mean)
TPU v7x (this work)
MaxText train_rl + tunix 0.1.8 + vLLM-TPU, Pathways, 64 chips (4x4x4)
JobSet on GKE/Kueue; 17 fixes applied at pod start (patches ConfigMap)
fp32 master/Adam, bf16 compute & rollout; checkpoints every 20 steps
stdout telemetry: EVAL-V2ACC, EVAL-BREAKDOWN, TIS-ACTIVE(k3, ESS), RLMETRIC
step time 34.6 / 36.2 s (seed 42 / 43 medians)
One scorer for both platforms: boxed_math_reward_v2.compute_score (hash-verified copy of the GPU fixture)

extract the last \boxed{…} → normalise → compare to the GSM8K gold → score 1.0 (correct) / 0.1 (boxed but wrong) / 0.0 (no box). acc = share of 1.0. Not MaxText's own `accuracy` (lenient math_verify; 78.1 % vs 81.5 % at step 0).
per-question JSONL dumps on both sides (qhash = sha1(question)[:12]) → question-level diff: wrong→right / right→wrong counts, boxed rate, response length.
Per-step telemetry compared in the same units: training reward, k3 KL, ESS, max IS weight, rollout tokens, wall time per update.
Parity standard

Gate: TPU step-250 accuracy (seed mean) ≥ GPU step-250 3-seed mean − 1 pp = 92.42 − 1.00 = 91.42 %. Curve: every eval point within ±1 pp of the GPU mean, judged against the single-run Wilson 95 % width (±1.4 pp at n = 1319).
Also required: same boxed-rate trajectory, same question-flip counts, sampler/trainer mismatch (k3 KL, ESS) in the GPU range, step time within the GPU seed spread.
Result 2026-10-27: 92.57 ≥ 91.42 → PASS. 27 of 27 eval points within ±1.2 pp (mean delta +0.24 pp).
